name: KDX Realty Investment Corporation
summary: Operating as a real estate investment trust (REIT), KDX Realty Investment Corporation specializes in acquiring various property types. The company's portfolio primarily comprises office, residential, and retail structures strategically situated across Tokyo and other key economic zones. Notable holdings include the KDX Nihonbashi 313 Building, Higashi-Kayabacho Yuraku Building, Harajuku FF Building, Ark Mori Building, Ginza 4-chome Tower, and the Portas Center Building, among others. Kenedix Real Estate Fund Management Inc. manages the assets for KDX Realty. This Tokyo-headquartered firm was established on May 6, 2005.
